task.title: Codify loop-owned gate and source-of-truth contracts
task.summary: Define loop gate evidence contracts and source-of-truth ownership so decision owns semantic KB, planning owns roadmap/work, implementation owns code/evidence, and publication stays under implementation.

goal.outcome: Decision, planning, and implementation loop gates enforce source-of-truth ownership: decision updates semantic KB, planning owns roadmap/work decomposition, implementation owns code/evidence, and publication stays under implementation.
acceptance: Source or policy contract exposes loop gate evidence ownership for decision, planning, and implementation without adding validation or publish loop roots.
Decision gate/reporting blocks approved semantic rows without row-to-KB/diagram mapping or explicit no-KB/no-diagram-impact rationale.
Planning gate/reporting routes stale, contradictory, or missing semantic KB back to decision and blocks executable accepted rows without roadmap/sprint/work-unit ownership.
Implementation/task-close reporting blocks or routes code changes that leave KB, diagram, source-contract, or file-structure drift without durable residual issue coverage.
Evidence reporting distinguishes tests and linters as evidence providers from loop gate criteria owners.
Implementation/publication criteria stay under implementation, including task-close and ship-ready compatibility behavior.
File-structure/source-contract checks align with exactly three loop roots and no fourth validation/publish root.
TASK-specific tests cover loop-owned evidence contract shape, source-of-truth ownership gate checks, publication-under-implementation invariant, and no fourth loop/root.
non_goals: Do not physically migrate all gateway/checks/policy helpers unless needed for contract clarity.
Do not create src/validation or src/publish roots.
Do not change public tool schemas except compatibility-safe additions.
Do not add CodeWiki-repo-specific dogfood behavior.
Do not make planning or implementation silently mutate semantic KB truth.
verification: targeted TASK-115 test for loop-owned gate/source-of-truth contracts
